kernel.title: Pi kernel version management
kernel.desc: Maintains only ~/.pi-desktop/pi. Pick a version to install (newer = upgrade, older = downgrade); the desktop doesn't touch PATH's pi.
kernel.configDesc: Edit pi's base config (~/.pi/agent/settings.json). Common keys have descriptions; the rest auto-render (base upgrades don't lose fields).
kernel.customCli.title: Custom pi base
kernel.customCli.desc: Use a pi base from a directory you specify (your own build or a modified fork). Two layouts are recognized: package source root (with dist/cli.js) / npm install directory. Takes effect for new sessions; running sessions will be marked for restart.
kernel.customCli.placeholder: Enter or choose a base directory…
kernel.customCli.appliedWithPending: ✓ Active — version {{version}} · {{count}} running session(s) marked for restart
kernel.customCli.cleared: ✓ Cleared — fell back to data-root install
kernel.customCli.overrideHint: ⓘ A custom base is active; installs below only write to the data root
